name: 15-stale-tick-fresh-updatedAt-sl
why: The SL (1995) is crossed by a quote whose tickAt is 60 s old while updatedAt is 1 s old (EA heartbeat on a frozen feed). No usable price on either engine: the SL must NOT fire.

knownDivergence.note: Until Stage 2 F2 the engine still counts a position without a usable price in used margin (at its open price), which also puts it in margin call; the web counts it nowhere. The close decision already matches (F4).
